title: Bigger status effect icons
description: Enlarge single status effects above health bars, such as Haze's Fixation stacks. Find the sliders under Icons, Status effect sizes.

title: HP percent
description: Show each hero's health as a percent of max health beside the HP number (200 / 10%), or the percent alone. Set it per side under HP Text; it needs Custom HP number on.

title: Kill bounty
description: See under each enemy hero's bar how many souls you get for killing them alone now, the number on the kill popup. Enemies with more souls than your team's average are worth more, and more again when your team is behind.

title: Deferred damage color
description: Shiv's Bloodletting and Nurse Harrow's Vapors turn part of the bar orange on every hero. Pick your own color for it on each side, so a white ally no longer looks like an enemy.

title: Status effects move with the bar
description: The pickup offsets now move every status effect icon, debuffs included, and the icons follow your bar position. Pickups on health bars keep the game's size and gaps; the size and spacing settings now set only the top bar's pickups.

title: Unit bars keep their layout
description: Customized neutral camps and objective bars now keep the game's bar layout and change only colors. The neutral camp and objective HP numbers can always show and each has its own position and tilt. Customize NPC bars was removed.

title: Colorblind view remembered
description: Your COLORBLIND choice is now saved and turns back on by itself after a game restart.

title: Colorblind view
description: See the whole screen as Protanopia, Deuteranopia or Tritanopia color blindness does. Turn on more than one to mix them.

title: Greyed-out settings
description: Settings that need another switch grey out while it is off. Hover one to see what to turn on. Tooltips now open above the row, not over the preview.

title: Feedback
description: FEEDBACK now sits under the preview between CREDITS and DONATE. It opens a window with my Discord name; click the name to copy it.

title: Sharper ultimate badge
description: The ultimate progress badge is now a vector icon: the game's ultimate eye inside the ring, sharp at any size.

title: Neutral camp bars
description: Customized neutral camps now flash your enemy Damage delta color, and with BAR STYLE OLD they use the full-width bar instead of half-empty boxes.

title: Team name colors
description: Hero names can take their team's color instead of your name color.

title: Team colors
description: Pick your own Amber and Sapphire colors. Team high color and the team HP number, stamina and name colors use them.

title: Team HP numbers
description: The HP number can take its team's color, or use it as the high color with your own colors.

title: Team stamina colors
description: Dash charges can take their team's color instead of your stamina color.

title: Low stamina color
description: Dash charges change color when this many or fewer are left.

title: Ally stamina settings
description: Ally dash charges now have their own color, size, position and shape.

title: Preview team switch
description: Switch the preview between Amber and Sapphire, next to Enemy and Ally.

title: Old shield bar
description: Bring back the HUD from before the September update: a separate green shield bar, and a white health bar and HP number without the shield.

title: New ICONS tab
description: Level, ultimate, pickup and rejuvenator settings moved from INDICATORS to ICONS. Related settings now share a card.
